sources.entry: Build A ToDo App With React Native

summary.title: Tutorial: Fullstack React Native with GraphQL and Authentication
summary.one_liner: You learn how to build a React Native to-do app backed by a Hasura GraphQL Engine, with Auth0 login and Apollo Client Query and Mutation components.
keywords: how to add login to react native app
takeaways: Deploy a Hasura GraphQL Engine and create users and todos tables with foreign key relations.
Set up an Expo React Native project and add Auth0 login via Expo AuthSession, storing session data in AsyncStorage.
Configure an Apollo Client with the GraphQL endpoint and a JWT Authorization header.
Fetch todos with Apollo's Query component and write data with Mutation components, plus Hasura subscriptions and logout.
summary.summary: This tutorial walks through building a fullstack to-do app with React Native, Apollo Client, Hasura GraphQL Engine as the backend, and Auth0 for authentication. It covers deploying Hasura, defining users and todos tables, scaffolding an Expo project, and wiring up login with JWT-based Apollo configuration. The later sections show how to use the react-apollo Query and Mutation components to fetch and insert todos, and list remaining steps such as subscriptions and logout. The code snippets are described on the page as pseudo code, and the page is an older article using the pre-Hooks react-apollo API.
